newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia Oct palm oil output up 1.1 pct - growers.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia Oct palm oil output up 1.1 pct - growers.

text.p: The Malaysian Oil Palm Growers' Council (MOPGC) has estimated Malaysia's crude palm oil output in October at 874,000 tonnes, up 1.1 percent from September, traders who obtained the data said on Friday.
Private crop forecaster Ivan Wong on Thursday estimated a 1.8 percent increase in October production to 880,000 tonnes.
The Palm Oil Registration and Licensing Authority is due to release official October crop data at 0430 GMT.
